2115922351833350301.en_summary: From the call, it’s clear $AMZN management wants the Street to think of the company as a AI data center and chips company. Forget retail. Giving two-year AWS revenue growth guidance of 40%+ in each of 2027 and 2028, above the just-reported 39%. They typically only guide AWS one quarter out. AWS will be a trillion-dollar business in 5–10 years. In CY28 the Street is at $306B. Bottom line: AWS is going to be much, much bigger.
2115922351833350301.zh_summary: 從電話會議中清楚看到，$AMZN 管理層希望華爾街將公司視為AI數據中心和晶片公司，忘掉零售。提供2027和2028年每年40%以上的AWS收入增長指引，高於剛公佈的39%。他們通常只指引AWS一季。AWS將在5至10年內成為萬億美元業務。CY28年華爾街預期為3060億美元。總之：AWS將會大得多。

ticker_notes.AMZN: 提供2027-2028年40%+ AWS增長指引，目標萬億美元業務

2115919782193279442.en_summary: $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy was asked about the slowdown in AWS's QoQ growth despite accelerating YoY growth. He attributed quarterly fluctuations partly to uneven capacity additions: "We add a lot of capacity every quarter. Now, the amount that we add every quarter is not equal. And we're adding different amounts each quarter."
2115919782193279442.zh_summary: $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy 被問及AWS季環比增長放緩但同比加速的原因。他將季度波動部分歸因於不均衡的產能增加：「我們每季都增加大量產能。但每季增加的數量並不相等。我們每季增加不同數量。」
